definitions.explanation: The historical period from the late 19th century to the mid-20th century (or in some contexts, to the present).

examples.japanese: {近代|きんだい}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧
{近代|きんだい}{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}に→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧{近代|きんだい}{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めてきた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has rapidly advanced modernization since the Meiji era.

notes:
{近代|きんだい} refers to the modern era in history.

HISTORICAL PERIODS:
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧ (ancient times)
- ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧ (medieval times)
- ⟦{近世|きんせい}→近世：14399_kinsei⟧ (early modern period)
- {近代|きんだい} (modern era - Meiji to WWII)
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧ (contemporary/present)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {近代|きんだい}⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧ (modernization)
- {近代|きんだい}⟦{史|し}→史：noentry⟧ (modern history)
- {近代|きんだい}⟦{的|てき}→的：noentry⟧ (modern, up-to-date)
- {近代|きんだい}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (modern literature)
